title.narrative: Empowering the San: Legal Capacity building for Human Rights Access

description.narrative:
The overall objective of this project is to support the inherent dignity of the San through the improvement of their living conditions, with the specific objective therefore to improve access through basic constitutional rights. In order to support the output of capacitating the San to claim their human rights the following must take place:

¿awareness raising as to what are these rights;

¿education as to the content of such rights; and

¿legal support to access these rights.
